description: `const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, initialArg, init?)`. Centralizes state transitions in a reducer function.
A pure function `(state, action) => nextState`. No mutation, no side effects.
A value describing what happened, usually `{ type: 'added', ...payload }`.
Sends an action to the reducer. Its identity is stable across renders.
Returning new arrays/objects (`...spread`, `map`, `filter`) instead of mutating, so React detects the change.
